text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Resume Written in Chinese or in English 8. Information Form For CUP Foreign Students
